content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am having trouble getting [product_name] [version_no] to run smoothly. My previous setup used [version_no] on a MacBook with El Capitan OS X 10.11, but newer hardware requires [version_no]. I've switched to a MacBook running Mojave 10.14.6 and installed Amazon Corretto 11 before using my old CD to install [version_no] from the [company_name] website. I'm consistently getting error popups when I attempt actions like "file -> Properties," "file -> message text settings," or "tools -> select hardware." Several other actions also trigger the popup—screenshot is attached. Has anyone seen this before or have suggestions?

Hi [user_name], Were any changes made to the Java files during installation? Where did you obtain the software—directly from [company_name] support portal, software package, or a third party? Make sure you have full administrator permissions for installation and usage. Also, does this error occur when working with any project you create? Best regards!

To my knowledge, the Java files were not modified during installation. The upgrade to [version_no] was obtained from [company_name] support portal. I have full admin rights. The error appears in both new and old projects. I can open and transfer existing projects to new hardware using [version_no], but an error pops up when trying to select hardware or configure the clock within [product_name].

For the error you're facing, consider these troubleshooting steps: 1. Reinstall [version_no] in a new directory. 2. Verify the Java runtime version is 11 and specifically from Amazon Corretto. Running 'java_home' in the terminal will show your default Java runtime in use.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing frequent popup errors in [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS Mojave when accessing crucial menu options such as hardware selection or message text settings. These errors prevent essential configuration steps, despite the software appearing to be installed correctly and system compatibility checks passing. The problem persists across both new and pre-existing projects, impairing basic functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] [version_no] to run reliably on MacOS Mojave, supporting all project types without functional error interruptions. Menu actions like hardware selection and message text configuration should work smoothly and without issue.
